description: Names that two files define on purpose. repo-tools map reads this file and tags each match ALLOWLISTED in duplicate-symbols.md.

entries.reason: Each name is a renderer wrapper in src/platform/index.ts. The wrapper calls an IPC channel of the main process. A function of the same name sits on the other side of that channel, in core/ or in electron/. The renderer imports no runtime module of core, only the types in core/types. The two definitions are the two sides of the IPC boundary, not a copy.
